answer: A durable Sybil barrier prices identity with escrowed, audited work. A newcomer clears thirty-two reviewed jobs, locks 200 units for two epochs, and wins four vouches from veteran peers whose ledgers never overlap. A clone reruns every job and posts fresh collateral, and a disproved job forfeits it wholly. Since receipts cannot recur and vouchers cannot be shared, borrowed standing is empty, so each extra puppet costs far more than the influence it can ever collect. jade signal sparrow
